note: Black Hills National Forest campground beside East Spearfish Creek in a meadow under cliffs, about 2 miles off US-85 near Cheyenne Crossing at the head of Spearfish Canyon. Pull-through RV sites on a gravel loop, plus walk-in tent sites along the creek. --Claude
summary: FS page, off-season table, rec.gov facility/rates/catalog read: 13 sites (7 drive-through RV spurs 25-50 ft + 6 walk-in tent), all first-come; vault toilets, water in season; $26 per rec.gov 2026-2028 rate table (FS page still says $24; stored $24 updated); RV side mid-May to Sep 30, tent walk-ins year-round. Not waterfront kept (creek is a narrow willow-lined stream 17-20 m from the nearest RV sites). Pin fine.
flags: FEES: rec.gov rate table gives $26 for 2026 peak and the 2027/2028 FCFS seasons; the FS page still says 'Peak Season: $24'. Wrote $26 (AWH: trust rec.gov over agency pages).

SITES: rec.gov catalog has 14 sites; site 14 (RV/Trailer, equipment max 0, structure beside it on imagery) is probably the host site. FS says 13 - wrote 13. RV-usable: drive-throughs 02-07 (25-50 ft); 01 is a 20-ft vehicle pad.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept. East Spearfish Creek is a 2-4 m stream running along the south-west edge of the loop; nearest RV pads 04 (44.27450,-103.85178) and 03 (44.27461,-103.85143) are ~17-20 m from the channel, but the bank is a continuous willow/brush and spruce fringe on imagery, and stored evidence ('willow-lined, no pads on bank') agrees. The FS/rec.gov wording ('adjacent to ... Spearfish Creek', 'between a mountain stream and the rugged cliffs') is prose, not a site-level claim. A site photo showing an open bank at 03/04 would be needed for creekside.
PHONE: stored (605) 642-4622 is the Northern Hills Ranger District (FS page; unstaffed season); rec.gov gives (605) 872-7869 for in-season staff (concessionaire). No change proposed.
STATUS: 'Site Partially Closed' is the routine off-season (drive-in side closed after Sep 30).
PIN: stored 44.27500,-103.85060 = FS page coordinates, in the meadow ~70 m north-east of the RV loop (sites 02-07 centroid ~44.2748,-103.8514) - fine, under the threshold.
